restaurant_name: YDC Dental Clinic (กรุงเทพกรีฑา)
text:
The clinic's appearance is very luxurious, but the actual service and treatment was extremely disappointing.

I went for a checkup because I had a sensitive tooth. The doctor requested three X-rays, but the dental assistant who performed them seemed very inexperienced and could not get the correct angle. As a result, the X-rays had to be repeated multiple times. In total, I had either eight or nine X-rays—so many that I lost count—meaning I was unnecessarily exposed to excessive radiation.

Furthermore, the doctor's attitude was quite indifferent. She did not seem interested in answering questions or giving thorough advice about future treatment options, brushing techniques, etc., instead dismissing me and suggesting I consult with an orthodontist.

The most frustrating part was the excessive cost of the checkup. It was the most expensive checkup I have ever had in Thailand. The checkup fee alone was 400 baht, not including X-rays or sterilization costs. Despite this high cost, I felt the checkup was not very thorough and the limited advice given was unhelpful. The total cost was 1200 baht, without even receiving any treatment.

Therefore, I will not be a returning customer and will be looking for a new dental clinic for further treatment.
